name: VidWords YouTube
description: Search a YouTube video's transcript and read its frames — slides, charts, demos and on-screen text — with every answer citing a clickable timestamp.
author: VidWords

tools.name: search_transcript
tools.description: Search one or many YouTube videos for a phrase or topic and return the matching moments with timestamps and deep links you can cite.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the complete transcript text for one or more YouTube videos, or just the part between two timecodes.

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: Resolve a YouTube channel handle, URL or id to its recent uploads.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The caption tracks a video has — language code, name, and whether it is auto-generated — so you can pass the right `lang` to get_transcript instead of guessing.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Full-text search across every transcript this account has already saved, returning the matching moments with timestamps and deep links.

tools.name: list_library
tools.description: The videos this account has saved, newest first, with title, channel, language and whether the transcript is searchable with search_library.

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: The account’s Radar watchlists — the YouTube channels it monitors for new uploads — with how many new videos each has recorded.

tools.name: watchlist_activity
tools.description: The most recent videos Radar has recorded for one watchlist, newest first.

tools.name: account
tools.description: The plan, Cloud Request balance and AI Processing balance for the calling token.

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Start a deep visual analysis of a YouTube video: chapters, key moments, on-screen text and evidence tied to exact timestamps.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Fetch the analysis started by analyze_video.

tools.name: ask_video
tools.description: Ask a question against a finished analysis and get an answer whose citations are verified against the stored evidence: a visual claim must match a real recorded frame and a spoken one a real transcript segment, or it is dropped.
